none: PAS FindID 1013122: Early Medieval Coin: Penny of Edmund of England
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Penny of Eadmund, King of all England (939-946). Small chip lost. Obverse description: Small central cross pattee; initial cross pattee. Obverse inscription: +EADMV[N]D RX. Reverse description: Line of three small crosses pattee centrally, three pellets above and below; legend on two horizontal lines; detached rectangle; detached rectangle. Reverse inscription: CRIST / ?LINI? Diameter: 21.5mm, Weight: 1.24gms, die axis: possibly 12
